decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed shop front would be compatible with the appearance of the building, would not harm the street scene, and would provide level access for those with impaired mobility, in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1, S.4.2 and S.4.4
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the shop is occupied.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the shop shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor,a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level and a 400mm high kickplate.
description: Installation of new shop front to existing retail shop.
